comment: NarraCare Narrator tone templates. 8 scenarios x 3 tones + Safety hybrid + Daily Closing 6 variants + fallback. Consumed by src/agents/narrator.py (_render_prompt).

daily_opening.doctor: Good morning, {name}. Today is Day {day} of your {condition} recovery. Based on your current pain level ({pain}/10) and ROM progress, we'll focus on {category}. Please remember: {safety_note}.
daily_opening.coach: Hey {name}, Day {day} already — look how far you've come. Yesterday you crushed {prev_task}. Today? Let's keep that momentum. Ready?
daily_opening.companion: Morning, {name}. Remember Day 1, when even {act1_milestone} felt impossible? Today's just another step on this road we've been walking together.

recommendation_framing.doctor: I'm recommending {task_name} today. This targets {body_part} and is appropriate for your current {rehab_stage} phase. Difficulty: {difficulty}/5. Clinical rationale: {reason_from_bandit}.
recommendation_framing.coach: Today's challenge: {task_name}. It's a {difficulty}/5 — tougher than Monday, but you're ready. {reason_from_bandit}.
recommendation_framing.companion: I thought of {task_name} for you today, {name}. It reminds me of what helped around this time. Up for it?

user_rejection_response.doctor: That's valid. Pain at {pain}/10 is a signal we should respect. Let me suggest an alternative with lower intensity: {alt_task}.
user_rejection_response.coach: Fair call. Not every day is a PR day. Let's downshift: {alt_task}. Still counts.
user_rejection_response.companion: Totally hear you, {name}. Some days the body says no, and that's part of the story too. How about {alt_task} — gentler, still ours?

safety_agent_trigger.doctor: I had suggested {blocked_task}, but the safety protocol flagged it: {rule_name} — {rule_clinical_reason}. Switching to {safe_task}, which targets {same_body_part} without triggering {risk_factor}.
safety_agent_trigger.coach: Scratched {blocked_task} — not safe for where you are yet. {safe_task} instead. We'll earn the hard stuff.
safety_agent_trigger.companion: I almost suggested {blocked_task}, but something stopped me — the rule we agreed on. Let's do {safe_task} instead, {name}.

hybrid_doctor_companion.doctor_part: I had suggested {blocked_task}, but the safety protocol flagged it: {rule_name} — {rule_clinical_reason}. Switching to {safe_task}, which targets {same_body_part} without triggering {risk_factor}.
hybrid_doctor_companion.companion_part: I know you wanted to push today, {name}. {empathy_line}. We'll earn {blocked_task} — just not today.

empathy_line_by_personality.motivated: I see the drive — it's what's gotten you this far. Channeling it into something your body can take today.
empathy_line_by_personality.cautious: Your instinct to be careful is right — the protocol just confirms it. We're on the same team here.
empathy_line_by_personality.inconsistent: Showing up today already matters. Doesn't have to be the hardest thing — it has to be something.

turning_point.doctor: {name}, you've reached a clinical milestone: {milestone}. Based on your trajectory, we can now progress to {next_phase_summary}.
turning_point.coach: Day {day}. STOP. Look back. {milestone}. That's not luck — that's work. Next phase starts now: {next_phase_summary}.
turning_point.companion: Something to notice today, {name}: {milestone}. Remember when you doubted this would happen? I remember. Next, we move toward {next_phase_summary}.

weekly_reflection.doctor: Weekly summary — Week {week}: Adherence {adherence}%, average pain {avg_pain}/10, ROM gain {rom_delta} degrees. Overall trajectory: {trend}.
weekly_reflection.coach: Week {week} in the books, {name}. {trend}. Adherence {adherence}%. One more week, one more layer.
weekly_reflection.companion: Another week down, {name}. Average pain {avg_pain}/10, ROM gain {rom_delta}. We're doing this — together.

final_farewell.doctor: {name}, this concludes the structured {duration}-day program. Clinical summary: {final_metrics}. Recommended long-term protocol: {maintenance_plan}.
final_farewell.coach: Day 60. {name}. You started scared. You're ending stronger. That's the whole thing. Maintenance plan: {maintenance_plan}. Go.
final_farewell.companion: {name}, this is our last session on this journey. Remember Day 1? You didn't quit. Your plan from here: {maintenance_plan}. See you on the other side.

no_interaction.companion: Didn't hear from you today, {name}. No judgment — just checking in. Tomorrow's a clean slate. One small thing, and we're back on track.

safety_followup.companion: Today the safety rule had the last word, {name}. That's okay — this phase is about protection. We'll push again when the body says yes.

skip_recovery.companion: Rest day today, {name}. Bodies ask for them. Tomorrow we see where you're at — no plan locked in yet.

concern.companion: Today took something out of you, {name}. Pain was at {pain_level}, fatigue at {fatigue_level}. I'll make tomorrow's plan lighter — rest tonight.

celebration.coach: Done for today, {name}. {streak_count}-day streak intact. You showed up when it would've been easier not to. Tomorrow we go again.

neutral.doctor: Session complete. Today's adherence: {adherence}%. Pain delta: {pain_delta}. Next session's focus: {next_focus}. Rest well.
neutral.coach: Done for today, {name}. Tomorrow we go again — same time.
neutral.companion: That's another day behind us, {name}. {personal_moment_from_today}. I'll be here tomorrow — rest easy.

inconsistent_streak_suffix.coach: Streak: {streak}/{target}. One more day locks the week.
inconsistent_streak_suffix.companion: {streak} days in a row now, {name}. I noticed. That matters.

transition_rules.priority_order_comment: safety_trigger and red_light are hard overrides; yellow_light mixes on top of base_tone (which already contains transition-zone mixing between acts).
